data.desc: Traws Pharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing novel therapies to target critical threats to human health in respiratory viral diseases. Traws integrates antiviral drug development, medical intelligence and regulatory strategy to address real world challenges in the treatment of viral diseases. The Company is advancing novel investigational oral small molecule antiviral designed to have potent activity against difficult-to-treat or resistant virus strains.
